Importing the Necessary Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

url_311 = paste0(
  "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.csv",
  "?$where=created_date%20between%20",
  "'2025-01-01T00:00:00'%20and%20",
  "'2026-12-31T23:59:59'",
  "&$limit=1000"
)

complaints_df = read_csv(url_311)

glimpse(complaints_df)

```

We will just use some relevant categories related to quality of life

```{r}
quality_of_life_df = complaints_df |>
  filter(
    complaint_type %in% c(
      "Noise - Residential",
      "Noise - Street/Sidewalk",
      "Noise - Vehicle",
      "Noise",
      "Lead",
      "Indoor Air Quality",
      "Air Quality",
      "Water Maintenance",
      "Dirty Condition",
      "Rodent",
      "Illegal Dumping",
      "Street Condition",
      "Sidewalk Condition"
    )
  )

nrow(quality_of_life_df)
```

Now to get monthly summaries

```{r}
library(httr2)

get_311_data = function(start_date = "2025-01-01",
                        end_date = "2026-11-25") {

  complaint_types = c(
    "Noise - Residential",
    "Noise - Street/Sidewalk",
    "Noise - Vehicle",
    "Noise",
    "Lead",
    "Indoor Air Quality",
    "Air Quality",
    "Water Maintenance",
    "Dirty Condition",
    "Rodent",
    "Illegal Dumping",
    "Street Condition",
    "Sidewalk Condition"
  )

  types_sql = paste0(
    "'", complaint_types, "'",
    collapse = ", "
  )

  request("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.json") |>
    req_url_query(
      `$select` = paste(
        "date_trunc_ym(created_date) AS month,",
        "borough, complaint_type, count(*) AS n"
      ),
      `$where` = paste0(
        "created_date >= '", start_date, "'",
        " AND created_date < '", end_date, "'",
        " AND complaint_type IN (", types_sql, ")"
      ),
      `$group` = "month, borough, complaint_type",
      `$order` = "month, borough, complaint_type",
      `$limit` = 50000
    ) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    mutate(
      month = as.Date(month),
      n = as.integer(n)
    )
}
```

```{r}
quality_of_life_summary = get_311_data() 

quality_of_life_clean = quality_of_life_summary |>
  filter(borough != "Unspecified")

glimpse(quality_of_life_clean)
```

This data contains 6(?) boroughs, 13 complaint types, and 1946533 total complaints.
560 unspecified boroughs were removed.

Saving this CSV to github

```{r}
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)

write_csv(
  quality_of_life_clean,
  "data/nyc_311_quality_of_life_2025_2026.csv"
)
```
